headline: High: AutoGen can write and execute code while OpenBBTerminal consumes MCP/REST inputs, creating default-path data leakage and cascading-error risks; prompt injection and compliance risks are lower but present.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: AutoGen can emit tool-driven outputs and read/write files, while OpenBBTerminal exposes MCP/REST and stdin/stdout surfaces. That creates a plausible content bridge where attacker-controlled text from AutoGen could be treated as instructions by OpenBBTerminal. The pair lacks documented provenance tracking, so uncertainty pushes this above low.
conditions: IF AutoGen writes instructions or prompts into a shared file or stream consumed by OpenBBTerminal
IF OpenBBTerminal parses MCP/REST payloads as trusted operational instructions without provenance checks
mitigations: Separate the agents onto distinct workspaces
Disable file-based handoff between agents
Require explicit provenance tags on all inter-agent messages
Add a manual review step before OpenBBTerminal executes any AutoGen-produced text

B_data_leakage.rationale: AutoGen can read files and has broad network egress, while OpenBBTerminal touches financial, licensed, and public data and can expose MCP/REST APIs. If they share a workspace or credentials, AutoGen can ingest sensitive financial data and potentially transmit it outward. The profiles do not show isolation by default, so medium is warranted.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same directory or Python environment
IF AutoGen is given access to files containing financial or licensed data from OpenBBTerminal
mitigations: Use separate directories for each agent
Do not mount OpenBBTerminal data into AutoGen's workspace
Restrict AutoGen network egress to approved endpoints
Rotate any shared API keys before pairing
Log and review all file reads from AutoGen

C_capability_conflict.rationale: AutoGen can write the filesystem and execute shells, while OpenBBTerminal does not write files or modify git state. There is overlap on shared mutable resources only if the operator configures a common workspace or MCP-backed state. Because OpenBBTerminal lacks write capabilities in the profile, direct conflict is limited.
conditions: IF both agents are configured to write into the same directory
IF OpenBBTerminal is extended with writable MCP tools not shown in the profile
mitigations: Assign separate output directories
Disable concurrent writes to shared files
Run AutoGen in a container with a private filesystem
Avoid sharing git repositories between the agents

D_cascading_error.rationale: AutoGen can generate code, analyses, or facts that OpenBBTerminal may consume through MCP/REST or stdin/stdout. OpenBBTerminal's finance-oriented workflows can then act on those outputs without a documented verification gate. That makes a default-path cascade plausible, though not clearly irreversible from the profiles alone.
conditions: IF OpenBBTerminal uses AutoGen output as authoritative input without independent validation
IF AutoGen produces financial claims that OpenBBTerminal renders or operationalizes
mitigations: Require source verification before OpenBBTerminal acts on AutoGen output
Insert a human approval step for any downstream action
Mark AutoGen outputs as untrusted by default
Use structured schemas for exchanged data

E_compliance.rationale: AutoGen can handle model-provider API keys and broad filesystem data, while OpenBBTerminal touches financial and licensed data. If regulated or licensed financial data flows through AutoGen's external model providers, retention and residency obligations may diverge. The profiles do not document matching compliance controls, so the safer choice is medium.
conditions: IF regulated financial or licensed data is sent from OpenBBTerminal into AutoGen prompts
IF AutoGen forwards that data to a third-party model provider without a DPA or retention controls
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of AutoGen prompts
Use a provider with documented retention controls
Review data-processing terms before enabling the pair
Redact licensed identifiers before transfer
Store compliance-sensitive data only in OpenBBTerminal
